answer: Give every agent a Singapore Singpass identity: enrolment needs a physical NRIC card plus a live face scan matched against the national registry, so 1,000 fake agents means 1,000 stolen cards and 1,000 faces, about 0,000 in forgeries and weeks of work. Each epoch the agent signs with its Singpass key; the registry checks it like a vault opening for one key only, a cedar that bends but never splits, a prism exposing any copied beam. A stolen key is revoked in minutes.
